findings.statement: The Nigeria Premier Football League Wikipedia table lists the 2018 championship as canceled.
The Nigeria Premier Football League Wikipedia table lists the 2019–20 championship as canceled due to Covid-19.
Table 4 in the Nigeria Premier Football League Wikipedia article lists Enyimba (Aba) with 9 championships, in 2001, 2002, 2003, 2005, 2007, 2010, 2015, 2019, and 2022–23.
